impact: Money is rotating within AI rather than leaving it, which limits the damage to the broader AI trade from Nvidia's leadership crisis.
summary: Cerebras Systems rose about 12% to 16% after hours after a third-quarter revenue beat and a sharply raised full-year outlook. In the regular session, Broadcom closed up 5.48% and AMD and Arista also rose as traders rotated out of Nvidia into other AI chip and networking names.
title: Cerebras jumps ~12% after hours on raised guidance; Broadcom closed +5.5%
